startersHint: A starter fills in a script and sets the speed and text size. Change the words to your own, or paste your script.
unsupported: This browser cannot record the camera. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a recent phone or computer. You can still use Practice to rehearse.
scriptHint: Paste or type what you want to read. Press Enter twice for a gap between parts. The script stays in this browser so it is here next time, and is never uploaded.
speedHint: Start slower than you think and adjust while you read. You can also change it during the recording.
voiceHint: Turn off to record a silent video. Your browser asks for permission.
mirror: Flip the text like a mirror
mirrorHint: Only for reading from a mirror or glass in front of the camera. Leave off for normal use.
dim: Dim the camera behind the text
stageHint: Put the phone on a stand and look near the camera lens. The script only shows on your screen; the saved video has just you.
denied: The camera or microphone could not be opened. Allow them for this site in your browser settings and try again, or turn off Record my voice.
failed: The video could not be saved. Try again.
tooShort: The recording was too short to save. Record for a few seconds and try again.
mp4Note: Saved as an MP4 file that plays on phones, computers and WhatsApp.
webmNote: Saved as a WebM file because this browser cannot record MP4. It plays in most browsers; use the Video Compressor and Trimmer to make an MP4 if you need one.
notSaved: Your recording is kept in memory until you save it and is never uploaded. Only your script and settings are remembered in this browser.
